life.label: Buenos Aires
life.title: Buenos Aires
life.summary: Where I'm from and where I started writing code for a living in 2020.
life.body: Born and raised in Buenos Aires. In 2020 I started building websites professionally, first for local clients, then remotely.

life.label: Rome
life.title: Rome
life.summary: First stop of a trip with two friends.
life.body: Left Argentina with two friends. Rome was the first city, working from cafés between walks.

life.label: Madrid
life.title: Madrid
life.summary: Second European stop before heading to Asia.
life.body: A few weeks in Madrid, still travelling with the same two friends, before the jump to Southeast Asia.

life.label: Bangkok
life.title: Bangkok
life.summary: First stop in Asia. This is where the nomad chapter really began.
life.body: Bangkok was the entry point to Asia and the start of a fully remote routine: coworkings, night markets and shipping code across time zones.

life.label: Japan
life.title: Japan
life.body: Japan set the bar for attention to detail. A lot of that ended up in how I build interfaces.

life.label: Bali
life.title: Bali
life.summary: Island life and long working sessions.
life.body: Bali mixed surf mornings with long afternoons of deep work.

life.label: Vietnam
life.title: Vietnam
life.body: Da Nang is where I live and work now. Most of the projects on the other tab were built from here.

life.label: Thailand
life.title: Thailand
life.body: Thailand keeps pulling me back between projects.

work.label: Nomad Events
work.title: Nomad Events
work.summary: Community events platform for Da Nang, rebuilt from the client's original site.
work.body: Paid registration with QR check-in, galleries and an admin panel. Built with Next.js and Neon Postgres.

work.label: E-commerce
work.title: E-commerce & Admin Panel
work.summary: A full store with admin panel, real-time stock, orders and email notifications.
work.body: Built with Next.js. Database, storage and admin login auto-provisioned, Stripe and Resend for payments and email.

work.label: Landing Page
work.title: Landing Page
work.summary: A custom landing page with animations and email capture.
work.body: Pixel-perfect layout, motion on scroll and a Resend-backed email capture form.

work.label: Social Links
work.title: Social Links
work.summary: A hosted social links page with custom URL, themes and click analytics.
work.body: Multi-tenant links page: custom slug, themes and per-link click analytics.
